text:
Sasha: Quick Q — I started the gke module refactor. Moving service account secret mapping out of the module into a cluster-level output and hoisting provider to root. CI in staging shows a plan-time failure. Do we need to keep explicit provider pins inside each module or is a root `required_providers` + root provider enough? Also, .terraform.lock.hcl got churned.

Raj: Can you paste the plan error? Root provider is usually fine unless modules declare `provider = google.something` with aliases.

Sasha: here's the relevant bits from the plan and the module provider blocks:
```
Error: Multiple provider configurations
  on .terraform/modules/gke/main.tf line 4, in resource "google_container_cluster" "primary":
4: resource "google_container_cluster" "primary" {

More than one provider configuration is present for provider "registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/google".
```
Module snippet:
```
provider "google" {
  project = var.project_id
  region  = var.region
}
```

Ashley: PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/489 — left a couple of comments. Two quick notes: keep the k8s SA secret path unchanged (`k8s/service-accounts/${sa_name}`) or downstream services will break, and add a note in the module README about provider expectations.

raj: If modules include an explicit `provider "google" {}` block Terraform treats them as separate provider configurations. Remove those module-local provider blocks and rely on root provider, or add `alias = "module"` and reference it. For pinning: pin in the root `required_providers` and regenerate the lockfile in CI with `terraform init -upgrade`.

infra-oncall: Staging smoke after pinning to `hashicorp/google 4.45.0` looked ok for basic apply. But autoscaler tests flaked — looks unrelated, file an issue if flakes continue. :eyes:

terraform-bot: [CI] plan failed in workspace `staging` — lockfile mismatch. Run `terraform init -upgrade` and commit the updated .terraform.lock.hcl. See pipeline: https://ci.redwood.ai/blue/organizations/jenkins/infra/detail/PR-489/12/pipeline

Sasha: ok I'll remove provider blocks from the modules and push a lockfile regen. Quick question: do we want to keep per-module version constraints in module `versions.tf` (e.g., `>= 4.0, < 5.0`) or centralize everything in root?

Ashley: centralize in root if possible. Modules should be tolerable but not pin hard. Put a short compatibility note in module README.

Raj: agree — root-level version constraint + lockfile committed is our pattern. After you push, can you comment here so I can kick the staging plan again?

Sasha: will do, pushing a branch in ~15m. thanks y'all :thumbsup:

infra-oncall: leaving a reminder to run the `smoke/cluster-autoscaler` test once staging plan succeeds. I'll watch the run.

terraform-bot: [Reminder] Don't forget `terraform validate` in module CI; it caught a missing variable in a follow-up commit earlier.

Sasha: pushed, PR updated. pinging @raj @ashley for quick recheck.

Raj: reviewing now.

Ashley: quick lgtm from me after CI green, I'll approve then. :rocket:
